text: DSH Remote Groups 把 Android 手机群聊接入电脑上的 DSH。插件入口加载远程连接和群聊组件，手机连上同一服务后可查看群组、选择成员并发送消息，协调电脑上配置的多个 Agent。适合需要移动访问 DSH、在群聊中组织 Agent 协作的用户；需准备远程服务账号和电脑端 Agent。

DSH Remote Groups connects Android chats to DSH on a computer. Its plugin loads remote access and group chat components so phones can view groups, choose members, and coordinate agents. It suits users needing mobile DSH access; a service account and configured computer-side agents are required.

DSH Remote Groups 的功能「手机远程连接」：Android 客户端通过远程连接服务连接电脑上的 DSH，并进入群聊查看会话。 通过电脑端插件入口与 Android 客户端使用。
DSH Remote Groups 的功能「多成员群聊」：用户可在群聊中选择电脑上已配置的成员，向一个或多个 Agent 发起协作。 通过电脑端插件入口与 Android 客户端使用。
DSH Remote Groups 的功能「连接配置」：插件配置允许设定连接角色、服务地址和设备名称，并提供默认远程服务地址。 通过电脑端插件入口与 Android 客户端使用。
DSH Remote Groups 的功能「桌面与 TUI 接入」：插件入口根据 DSH 注入服务选择桌面或 TUI 接入，并安装相应的远程运行时。 通过电脑端插件入口与 Android 客户端使用。

出门时怎么从 Android 连接到我的 DSH？

**把电脑上的 DSH 和多个 Agent 放进同一个群聊，用 Android 手机继续聊天、分配任务、传文件和处理审批。** 电脑负责运行 Agent，手机是操作入口；成员、群聊和消息保存在电脑端。

可以让主持人整理任务、指定 Codex 检查代码、让 Claude 审阅方案，也可以让多个成员依次交流。工作、闲聊都可使用；具体能做什么取决于电脑上的模型、CLI 和权限配置。

dsh-remote-groups README · DSH Remote Groups：这是 Seren-715 维护的社区衍生项目，基于 [ds-harness-remote](https://github.com/liguobao/ds-harness-remote) 和 [DeepSeek-Bot](https://github.com/Fei2411/DeepSeek-Bot)。不是上述项目或 DeepSeek、OpenAI、Anthropic 的官方发布。

text:
dsh-remote-groups README · 下载：电脑端二选一，手机端共用一个 APK：配套版也携带增强运行组件，功能、体积与完整版接近。它不是只依靠任意原版上游工作的轻量桥接。已在用本项目完整版的人直接更新完整版即可。

1. 在 DSH 插件管理中安装所选电脑包、启用并正常重启。配套版在上游之后安装/启用。
2. 打开本插件的 Remote 设置，完成连接服务登录与电脑主机授权。
3. 在电脑上配置 Agent 的登录、模型、工作目录及群聊成员。
4. 手机安装 APK，登录同一连接服务、信任并连接电脑，然后进入“群聊”。

默认 Bot 数据与 Remote 身份目录沿用；自定义 `home`、服务地址和 CLI 配置需在新入口重新应用。安装器需要联网下载普通依赖，电脑与 Host 需要保持运行。完整步骤、升级/回退及加载顺序见 [安装说明](docs/INSTALL.md)。

text:
dsh-remote-groups README · 使用前需要知道：- **额度来自各成员实际使用的账号/服务。** 本插件不附送模型额度，不自动安装或登录各 CLI；图片识别是否产生额外调用取决于所用模型与配置。
- 当前 CLI 成员使用群聊专用会话，尚未接入已有桌面窗口或历史会话复用。不是把桌面应用窗口直接拉进群里。
- 手机目前读取最近 **60 条群消息**；可展开其中长消息的完整内容，尚不支持继续分页查看更早消息。
- 前台约每 **3 秒**刷新群状态与消息。固定审批面板不是应用关闭后仍可收到的系统后台通知。
- 文本草稿保存到手机应用私有文件；附件草稿仍属于当前页面，退出或重启后需重新选择。
- 当前是预览版。安装组合、原生模拟器布局和发送已有验证，真实手机网络、系统选择器和各 Agent 的实际回复仍受环境影响；完整 Remote 回归仍有未通过项，见 [验证记录](docs/VERIFICATION.md)。

**Bring DSH and multiple locally running Agents into one group, then use Android to continue conversations, assign tasks, transfer attachments and answer approvals.** The computer runs the Agents and stores group data; the phone is a remote interface.

dsh-remote-groups README · DSH Remote Groups：This community derivative is maintained by Seren-715, based on [ds-harness-remote](https://github.com/liguobao/ds-harness-remote) and [DeepSeek-Bot](https://github.com/Fei2411/DeepSeek-Bot). It is not an official release of those projects, DeepSeek, OpenAI or Anthropic.

dsh-remote-groups README · Interface preview：These are **browser-rendered demonstrations using the current Android components and invented members, messages and tasks**. They do not show live Agent execution or a physical phone. Fonts, keyboard and system file pickers can differ on Android. [Screenshot provenance](docs/images/README.md).

dsh-remote-groups README · Features and controls：| Feature | Where and how |
| --- | --- |
| Shared rooms | Connect to and trust the computer, then open Groups to use existing rooms or create a room from desktop-configured members. |
| Multiple runtimes | Add DSH, Codex CLI, Claude Code, OpenCode and Hermes members configured on the computer. CLI members use dedicated group sessions. |
| Direct mentions | Type `@` for candidates above the composer, long-press a member avatar, or select a member from the `+` menu. `@all` invites everyone. |
| Moderated discussion | Open group information to choose moderator-first delegation or sequential replies and set the cumulative reply budget. This is not parallel execution. |
| Images and files | Use `+` to select attachments, remove them before sending, monitor/cancel uploads and tap historical cards to fetch attachments from the computer. |
| Approvals and stopping work | Approvals stay below the group title, with details, allow-once and deny actions. Use the stop button on an active member card to stop that member's work in this group. |
| Reading and drafts | New messages/approvals preserve the reading position. Jump to latest explicitly;

dsh-remote-groups README · Download: choose one computer package：1. Install and enable the chosen archive in DSH, then restart normally. Install/enable the companion after upstream bundles.
2. Complete connection-service login and Host authorization in the plugin's Remote settings.
3. Configure model/CLI accounts, working directories and members on the computer.
4. On Android, sign into the same connection service, trust/connect to the computer, and open Groups.

dsh-remote-groups README · Download: choose one computer package：Default Bot and Remote identity directories are reused. Custom `home`, service address and CLI settings must be reapplied to the new entries. Installation needs network access for ordinary dependencies. Keep the computer and Host running. See [installation/migration](docs/INSTALL.md) for ordering, upgrade and rollback boundaries.

dsh-remote-groups README · Current limits：- The plugin includes no model allowance and does not install/log into Agent CLIs. Usage belongs to each member's configured provider/account; image understanding depends on its model and configuration.
- Existing desktop application windows and prior sessions are not attached. CLI members use group-specific sessions.
- Mobile history currently contains the most recent **60 group messages**, with long-message expansion but no pagination to older messages.
- Foreground state/messages refresh approximately every **3 seconds**. The fixed approval panel is not an OS background push notification.
- The UI's reply-limit setting is a **cumulative member reply budget**, including mention hand-offs, not N full rounds or N replies per member. The configurable range is 1–40; blank uses the default budget.
- Attachment limits: 8 per message, at most 4 images; 20 MiB per item, 30 MiB total image bytes. Historical cards fetch data on demand. The chat displays user text and images while retaining model-reading context separately.
- Text drafts persist in private app storage; attachment drafts belong to the current screen lifecycle.
